raw.description: Ralph MCP off and proxy-shell/native-result compaction disabled: RALPH_MODE=no leaves native hooks off and Ralph MCP unused, so shell output flows through unmodified. Source-listing commands such as find, ls, and tree are never compacted on the shell path, and with RALPH_NATIVE_RESULT_COMPACT=0 native read/grep/glob results are also left untouched.

ralph-read-heavy.description: Ralph MCP active with proxy-shell compaction on for known-noise command families only. Source-listing commands (find, ls, tree) are never compacted on the shell path, even in this profile. The generic fallback stays off so unknown large output is left untouched, and RALPH_NATIVE_RESULT_COMPACT=0 keeps native read/grep/glob results unwindowed.

ralph-compact.description: Ralph MCP active with proxy-shell compaction on and the generic fallback enabled at a 16384-byte threshold, so unknown large shell output beyond that size is also compacted. Source-listing commands (find, ls, tree) are never compacted on the shell path. RALPH_NATIVE_RESULT_COMPACT=0 keeps native read/grep/glob results unwindowed; the only source-output dial is RALPH_NATIVE_RESULT_COMPACT, and it is off here.

ralph-aggressive.description: Ralph MCP active with proxy-shell compaction on and the generic fallback lowered to a 4096-byte threshold for maximum unknown-output trimming. RALPH_NATIVE_RESULT_COMPACT=1 windows native read/grep/glob results. Despite the aggressive setting, source-listing commands (find, ls, tree) are never compacted on the shell path; source output is never summarized on the shell path.
